question.text: How many points is speeding one to fifteen miles per hour over the limit?

answer.text: Driving one to fifteen miles per hour above the speed limit is an example of a two-point speeding violation.

question.text: How many points is speeding sixteen to twenty-five miles per hour over the limit?

question.text: Which violations are each listed at eight points?

question.text: What must be in effect before anyone drives a motor vehicle in Indiana?

question.text: Is Restriction two still added for habitual violator suspensions expiring on or after the start of twenty fifteen?

answer.text: Restriction two is no longer added to records for habitual violator suspensions or habitual violator probationary licenses expiring on or after January one, two thousand fifteen.

teaching.text: Restriction two has been retired for habitual violator suspensions and probationary licenses expiring from twenty fifteen on. Remember: Restriction two retired.

hooks_spoken: Speeding one to fifteen over is two points, sixteen to twenty-five is four, and twenty-six or more is six; points stay active two years.
An approved safety course earns a four-point credit once every three years, and a required course must be finished within ninety days.

hooks_spoken: Failing a chemical test means one hundred eighty days, refusing means a year, and refusing with a prior conviction means two years.
Your driver record is free to view online, and the official copy is the one you can print.
